practice.description: ITSM practice, e.g. service-request, incident, change, problem, asset

basedOn.description: reference-library artifact ids this design reuses (templates, schemas)

verifiedAgainst.description: site / template version the artifact was captured from

deliveredBy.description: design element ids in the reference design that deliver this outcome

evidenceHints.description: what ServiceNow evidence sets or overrides the parameters

templateKey.description: Atlassian project template key, e.g. the JSM IT service management template

systemFieldId.description: set when the reference uses a built-in field (summary, description, priority, components…)

assets.description: for assets-object fields: the design id of the Assets object type plus an optional AQL scope

start.description: conditions, e.g. "Issue created", "Entered status: Waiting for support"

templateId.description: Atlassian automation template this rule is based on

templateKey.description: Atlassian Assets schema template this schema starts from

purpose.description: ownership / permission boundary this schema represents

schemaId.description: omit for a global status type

parentId.description: design id of the parent object type (inheritance)

__schema10.description: id of the reference-library artifact this element is based on

__schema19.description: portal label, if it differs from the field name

keywords.description: matched case-insensitively against names, categories and descriptions
